text:
Store documents with embeddings and topic labels, ready for search by meaning. Save, read, list and delete records, and set each table's classification prompts. Start with upsert and a namespace.
upsert (JSON only): Store one record, replacing any record with the same id, once it is classified and embedded; nothing is saved if either step fails.; returns: Full record JSON, <=256 KiB with reconstructed embeddings and derived classification_ids(label->probability). Omitting key1/key2 clears them. Worst-case escaped-source, label and float32-vector budgets are refused before any paid call.
get (JSON only): Get one record as stored, or null when it does not exist.
list (JSON only): Browse record summaries in stable order, up to 16 per call; send the returned cursor for the next page.; returns: JSON {records:[summaries],cursor:string|null}; <=16 summaries, excluding data and embeddings, each <=32 KiB. Filters do not grant access; no snapshot guarantee across calls.
[destructive] delete (JSON only): Remove one record, or exactly the namespace-scoped selection you name.; returns: JSON {status:"ok"}, without a count. id requires tableName and forbids key1/key2/all; otherwise all:true is required. Deletes all revisions matching the compiled namespace filter, never prompt KV. Unknown outcomes explicitly say unknown; repeating is safe.
[destructive] prompts (JSON only): Read, replace or delete one table's classification prompts; existing records stay as they are.

Examples
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"upsert","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","id":"tea","data":"Tea is a drink."}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"get","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","id":"tea"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"list","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","limit":2}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"delete","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","id":"tea"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"prompts","action":"set","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","data":{"labels":{"drink":"Beverages","other":"Other topics"},"instructions":"Choose the topic."}}'

upsert.help: Store one record, replacing any record with the same id, once it is classified and embedded; nothing is saved if either step fails.

args.help: Required non-blank UTF-8 string, 1..128 bytes; no BOM, NUL or newline. Never optional for record operations. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization.
args.name: namespace

args.help: UTF-8 table name, 1..128 bytes; required for upsert/get/prompts, optional filter for list/delete. A table alone is never sufficient. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Same byte, BOM/NUL/newline and non-blank rules as namespace.
args.name: tableName

args.help: Exact record ID, 1..128 UTF-8 bytes; strings only, no numeric coercion. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization.
args.name: id

args.help: UTF-8 source, at most 32768 bytes; no BOM, NUL or invalid encoding. For application/json, supply JSON text. The source cap is an upper bound: whitespace break points can require more than 8 chunks and refuse early.
args.name: data

args.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Empty string is valid; omission in upsert clears it.
args.name: key1

args.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Empty string is valid; omission in upsert clears it.
args.name: key2

args.help: Content type; HTML excludes script/style, Markdown keeps its source, JSON is canonicalized for chunking.
args.name: mime-type

args.help: Optional array of vectors aligned with deterministic chunks, <=8 vectors and <=8192 total scalars. Each has configured dimensions; finite float32-range numbers only, no booleans. Storage round-trips float32; omission calls Voyage. Get returns reconstructed vectors; list omits them.
args.name: embeddings

upsert.returns: Full record JSON, <=256 KiB with reconstructed embeddings and derived classification_ids(label->probability). Omitting key1/key2 clears them. Worst-case escaped-source, label and float32-vector budgets are refused before any paid call.

args.help: Page size 1..16; summaries omit data and embeddings and are each <=32 KiB, leaving proxy reply headroom.

args.help: Opaque token from a prior list reply with the same filters/limit; expires after 10 minutes and on restart. At most 128 outstanding tokens; no raw backend offset accepted. Tokens bind the expected UUID offset shape and filters; when full, oldest token is evicted and later use returns an explicit stale-cursor error.

args.help: Prompt operation. Requires namespace and tableName. set requires data; get/delete forbid data.
args.name: action

data
args.help: For set only: object with labels (1..64 IDs, at most 128 bytes each, mapped to descriptions <=512 bytes), instructions (1..4096 UTF-8 bytes), optional threshold (finite 0..1, default 0.5), top_k (integer 1..64, default 5), summary (<=4096 UTF-8 bytes, stored for R.9). No extra keys; booleans are not numbers.

qdrant.help: Complete Qdrant proxy bus name; this app needs its own write grant

voyage.help: Complete embedding proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

ai.help: Complete Decisions proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

collection.help: Owner-created dedicated collection, 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen; never auto-created

embedding_model.help: Fixed embedding model ID, verified against collection metadata.embedding_model

dimensions.help: Fixed unnamed Cosine vector size, 1..8192; chunks times dimensions must not exceed 8192 Must also be an output dimension the chosen Voyage model supports; its refusal is not bypassed.

decision_model.help: Model for one Jev Choice call per record
